info.title: Studio Public API
info.description:
This API exposes document analysis operations through HTTP.
Only public endpoints are exposed under /v1.

## Authentication
All endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

post.description: Switches the workflow state (enabled/disabled) by its unique identifier

delete.summary: Delete data by document data id

schema.description: List of document data IDs to delete

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of data sources

get.description: Returns a workflow configuration by its unique identifier

delete.description: Deletes a workflow by its unique identifier

get.description: Returns the execution history of a specific run step identified by runId and stepId
Returns steps progress for a run by its unique identifier
Returns information about a run by its unique identifier

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key authentication using Authorization header. Format: 'Authorization: api-key {key}'
